tasks.note: The sweep found defect 30 (the collection page announced each item's name twice).

tasks.title: large text and landscape
tasks.note: Diagnosis rather than repetition: both deaths came after `settings put system font_scale 1.3` on an AVD already carrying a wm density override. The AVD has hw.gpu.enabled=no and runs on -gpu swiftshader_indirect, so the software rasteriser is doing the text relayout for every frame. Restarting the emulator cleared it (density and font_scale reset to the defaults, device up). Landscape was not attempted at all. This is NOT a pass.
tasks.evidence: PARTIAL, and the part that ran is clean: at 360x800 dp with the system font_scale at 1.3, the home page and the records page both rendered with zero RenderFlex overflow and a complete tree. The growth, room, dress and collection stops did NOT run: the emulator process died twice in a row, the second time mid-sweep.
